title: Change at the helm of the national team: Veniamin Dubrovin takes over the senior squad
excerpt: ATTP member Veniamin Dubrovin has been appointed head coach of the men's senior national team and makes his debut at the Balkan Championships in Sarajevo.
body_html:
The Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova has announced an important decision for the future of the national team: Veniamin Dubrovin, an ATTP member, has been appointed the new coach of the men's senior national team. The ATTP team welcomes him to the role and wishes him every success in taking the national side to a higher level of performance.

The new coach has no time to settle in: the challenge starts on day one. From 15 to 19 September 2026, the Balkan Senior Championships take place in Sarajevo (Bosnia and Herzegovina), where Veniamin Dubrovin will make his official debut on the national team bench.

At this competition Moldova will be represented by three young, ambitious players: Vladislav Ursu, Andrei Puțuntică and Cezar Cozmolici, all ATTP members and top players on the Setka Cup circuit. Under their new coach, the three are getting ready to compete with determination, commitment and the will to do the national colours proud.

ATTP sends its full support to both the players and the coach at this important moment for Moldovan table tennis.

Come on, Moldova! Good luck, boys, and good luck, Veniamin!
